rules: Bypass if transaction sequence likelihood is typical (rarity score > -1.0) and transaction amount is less than 500,000.00.
Bypass if transaction amount is less than 500,000.00 and frequency is normal (1-hour count <= 1.0 and 24-hour count <= 2.0).
Bypass if transaction channel is low-risk (Cable, Credit_card_repayment, Game, Lending_repayment, Lifestyle_payment, MCPP, Utilities_payment) and transaction amount is less than 5,000,000.
Block if account has been dormant for more than 90 days and transaction amount exceeds 10,000,000 and transaction is directed outside the bank.

Block if a security credential was changed within the last 1.0 hour(s) and transaction amount exceeds 10,000,000 and transaction is directed outside the bank and the customer has more than 10 historical transactions.
